msg: Roth deferrals are always after-tax. This row is flagged pre_tax, so taxable wages come out low.
Garnishments, child support and levies are withheld after tax. This row is flagged pre_tax.
tax_treatment is empty. Nothing in the map says whether this code reduces taxable wages.
This deduction code already appears above with a different tax_treatment.
Pre-tax row names no plan_basis (125, 401k, 403b, 457b, 132), so nothing supports the exclusion.
This box12 value is not an IRS W-2 Box 12 code letter.
Elective-deferral code carries no W-2 Box 12 letter (D, E, G, S, AA, BB, EE).
HSA contributions report in W-2 Box 12 under code W. This row does not carry W.
Box 12 code W is employer plus employee combined. This row has no employer_amount to add.
effective_date is older than the plan year being filed. Deduction limits reset every January 1.
effective_date is empty, so the row cannot be tied to a plan year.
A garnishment code is present but the map has no order column to rank it against other deductions.
